groups.title: Entry signer and owned work
groups.obligation: Request local PGP unlock immediately; retain approved signing environment, protect operator work and verify incremental signed commits.

groups.title: Current execution tuple
groups.obligation: Record branch/tree/drift, siblings, SDK/configuration, isolated resources and no execution pin.

groups.title: Fresh impact and regression baseline
groups.obligation: Use fresh CodeAnalytics or stated evidence-based fallback; reproduce source-derived findings without treating hypotheses as executed defects.

groups.title: Stable shared
groups.obligation: Reuse repository shared unchanged by default; one task archive, no version/manifest pin and no historical bundle rewrite.

groups.title: Actual HTTP producer closure
groups.obligation: Project+node HTTP preparation and compile consume one captured effective executable closure.

groups.title: Explicit empty drivers
groups.obligation: A published empty driver list never causes template driver contribution to reappear through HTTP or native producers.

groups.title: Authored settings and bindings
groups.obligation: Distinct authored/project driver settings and artifact bindings govern actual stored variables/assignments.

groups.title: Publication race consistency
groups.obligation: Held selection/enrichment followed by republish cannot create mixed-version preparation or plan.

groups.title: Replay before recomputation
groups.obligation: Retained intent returns original preparation/run without definition/context reload or enrichment and without duplicate effects.

groups.title: Producer input fingerprint
groups.obligation: Original raw producer input/caller semantics stay distinct from enriched variables and selected internal closure.

groups.title: Canonical supported input matrix
groups.obligation: Test key/id/omission/profile and supported normalization; reject explicit unknown/inconsistent identities, keep exact storage identity.

groups.title: Authority and public boundary
groups.obligation: No wire-deserialized trusted closure; capability/caller/profile/project lifetime/archive are checked at native boundaries.

groups.title: API descriptions and producer consumers
groups.obligation: Correct XML/OpenAPI drift, inspect all helper callers, preserve Workbench and captured-child producer behavior.

groups.title: Authentic predecessor fixtures
groups.obligation: Use provenance-backed old payloads with no closure and optional/no admission; verify serialization and plan hash integrity.

groups.title: Same-origin retained reuse
groups.obligation: Authoritatively provable legacy candidate reuses exact run/plan/assignments without resolving a replacement definition.

groups.title: Unproven is not absent
groups.obligation: Historical candidate with unproven origin yields safe actionable recovery/refusal, never automatic null-to-new-child behavior.

groups.title: Lifetime and profile isolation
groups.obligation: Different/recreated project, database profile and global/project mismatch do not acquire old authority or expose another origin.

groups.title: Full child recovery path
groups.obligation: Actual parent/subprocess re-entry covers active/completed/stopped children, bridges and retries with no duplicate child.

groups.title: Old state immutability
groups.obligation: Preserve accepted plans, receipts and payloads across upgrade/restart; no fabricated current-lifetime backfill.

groups.title: Resource-backed reimport
groups.obligation: Delete then ImportRole/ImportProcess in independent scopes succeeds under valid inputs without stale dictionary collision.

groups.title: Head resource ownership
groups.obligation: Usage/source/materialized keys handled consistently; no unrelated resource removal or global template mutation.

groups.title: AddRole reuse and references
groups.obligation: New role does not inherit deleted role defaults; role selection and owned visual references remain correct.

groups.title: Immutable history preservation
groups.obligation: Existing publications/receipt snapshots/prepared launches remain byte/hash stable across draft delete and import.

groups.title: Role replay conflict and postcommit
groups.obligation: Same operation replay allocates no new key/revision; stale version and lost response follow native receipt rules.

groups.title: Real HTTP/native proof
groups.obligation: Exercise actual API routes plus native producers with authoritative database/plan/variable assertions.

groups.title: Real role browser journey
groups.obligation: Drive resource-backed delete/import and fresh context/reopen through production renderers and read-back.

groups.title: Legacy operator path
groups.obligation: Show supported legacy reuse or explicit unresolved-origin outcome; full path asserts no second child.

groups.title: Restart and workflow floor
groups.obligation: Retain old preparation across later publication/new owned OS PID and exact native workflow/result completion.

groups.title: UI and integration preservation
groups.obligation: Protect dirty drafts, late results, canvas, files, chat/context/attachments, cancellation, voice and Workbench consumers according to impact.

groups.title: Fresh test assemblies and counts
groups.obligation: Changed filters list/discover exact expected and expanded cases; no zero-test pass or stale no-build evidence.

groups.title: Clean source dependency reproducibility
groups.obligation: Verify intended sibling tuple in clean isolated build; resolve CI/local pin difference with evidence, not blind repin.

groups.title: Portability and required broad gate
groups.obligation: Final static enforcement and impact-triggered broad campaign/qualified source bridge; no per-stage full-suite loop.

groups.title: Structural dependency and active census
groups.obligation: Verify real light UI/public/deferred/assets edges; classify residual native hosts without artificial extraction.

groups.title: Preserved transfer and schema boundaries
groups.obligation: No transfer guard removal, history loss or new schema workaround; owner/transfer/model checks remain valid.

groups.title: Truthful evidence and source checkpoints
groups.obligation: Exact source/sibling/test identities, reported versus executed outcomes, failure preservation and verified signed commits.

groups.title: Maintainable completion record
groups.obligation: Update current docs outside shared/historical bundles; state completed dimensions and remaining independent work.

note: Coverage groups, not test/class/file/commit counts. Scope is corrective implementation and integration closure, not a new persistence or UI extraction.
